paragraphs.text: Community DSH model adapter using official OpenAI Codex app-server and native ChatGPT login
# Codex Native for DSH
Use your ChatGPT account to work with Codex models inside DeepSeek Harness. Chat, share images, use
tools and skills, and continue longer tasks without leaving DSH.
简体中文 · What's new in 0.2.3
## What you can do
- **Sign in and choose a model:** use your ChatGPT account, refresh the models available to it, and
choose a model and thinking effort. New model choices and runtime updates are picked up when needed,

without a separate manual update routine.
- **Chat and work with images:** send text and images, us
e DSH tools, and continue conversations with their earlier tool results and image attachments, inclu

ding after a restart.
- **Carry out local tasks with permission:** connect Codex command and file-op
eration requests to DSH approval prompts. Approve an offered action once or reject it; the plugin do
es not silently grant lasting permission. Available actions still depend on your installed tools and

sandbox settings.
- **Answer questions in the conversation:** select an option or enter your own an

swer. Your answer is sent back to the task and shown in chat without another send step.
- **Find and
use skills:** search skills from local files and connected plugins, then read the instructions need
ed for the task. Choose DSH-managed discovery or the native skill catalog, and optionally set a skil

l-context budget.
- **Manage longer conversations:** use context compaction and overflow recovery, r
etain conversation continuity, and keep startup diagnostics out of replies and summaries. Explicit i

mage/context settings remain under your control.
- **Check account usage:** query quota and Token hi
story on demand, view daily totals and reference-period groups, and clear the displayed table before

querying again. Consumption totals and the current context window are tracked separately.
- **Use f
amiliar settings:** sign in or out, change native model settings, and use the bilingual interface wi

th DSH's current theme.
- **Maintain a supported Windows screenshot helper:** view troubleshooting g
uidance and status, repair the supported known helper, release a selected stuck helper or roll it ba
ck. Repair and interruption require confirmation. This assists an installed Computer Use setup; it d
oes not itself provide a desktop-control engine or fix every screenshot problem.

**Updating:** Use the same dialog with the new versioned source above, verify the installed version
and enable it. Retain existing settings and user files. If DSH reports that it is already installed

## Important limits
Approval prompts do not bypass the sandbox. Windows helper maintenance is Windows-only and supports
a specific known helper version; read its guidance before applying a repair. Linux and macOS runtime
selection is included, but this release does not claim new macOS live testing. See the release note
s for the verified scope and remaining test boundaries.

nse. Reference-period dates use codex-reset.com announcements.
